text:
```yaml
name: Changelog Enforcer

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  enforce:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Enforce changelog update
        uses: dangoslen/changelog-enforcer@v3
        with:
          changelog-file: CHANGELOG.md
          changelog-branch: main
```
